guides.title: Content phases and what each one changes
guides.summary: Burning Crusade content arrives in phases, and each phase changes which raids are open, which attunements still gate a door, what reputation a heroic key costs and where Badges of Justice drop. This guide is the timeline the addon syncs to, numbered the way Questie numbers it, with the 2026 Anniversary dates beside the 2021 to 2022 Classic dates. Every other guide reads its phase rules from here.
guides.unlocks: Finishing it unlocks nothing in game; it tells the addon which phase is live so every other guide can hide steps that no longer apply and surface the ones that do.

phase.notes: Questie numbering 1 to 5 is used throughout: 1 Karazhan/Gruul/Magtheridon, 2 Serpentshrine Cavern/Tempest Keep, 3 Hyjal/Black Temple, 4 Zul'Aman (Blizzard calls it Phase 3.5 on Anniversary and Phase 4 in 2022), 5 Sunwell and the Isle of Quel'Danas (Blizzard calls it Phase 4 on Anniversary and Phase 5 in 2022). Live on Anniversary today, 2026-10-24: phase 4, since 22 October 2026 15:00 PDT. Installed Questie 12.1.0 still reports 3; upstream Questie 12.2.0 released 2026-10-23 reports 4.

steps.title: Phase 1: Karazhan, Gruul and Magtheridon
steps.detail: Anniversary: patch 2.5.5 pre-patch 13 January 2026 (Dark Portal event, all normal 20th Anniversary realms moved into Burning Crusade), launch 5 February 2026 15:00 PST globally, Arena Season 1 from the 17 February 2026 weekly reset, Karazhan, Gruul's Lair and Magtheridon's Lair open 19 February 2026 15:00 PST. Classic 2021: pre-patch 18 May 2021, launch 1 June 2021 with the three raids open from day one, Arena Season 1 in mid June 2021 ending 7 September 2021. In this phase every heroic key (Flamewrought 30622 Alliance or 30637 Horde, Reservoir 30623, Auchenai 30633, Warpforged 30634, Key of Time 30635) costs Revered; on Anniversary the first character at Revered can also buy a Communal pouch (265842 or 265829 Flamewrought, 265844 Reservoir, 265846 Auchenai, 265848 Warpforged, 265850 Time Pouch from Alurmi 21643 for 80 gold) holding a Bind to Battle.net key an alt can use at Friendly. Karazhan needs The Master's Key 24490 from the Violet Eye chain (9837 Return to Khadgar, 9838 The Violet Eye) and on Anniversary a raid attunement done once unlocks that raid for the whole account. Badges of Justice 29434 drop only from heroic dungeon bosses, Wind Trader Zhareem 24369 pays 2 badges for the heroic daily, Nether-Stalker Mah'duun 24370 pays an Ethereum Prison Key for the normal daily, and G'eras 18525 in Shattrath is the only badge vendor. Flying mounts are available at 70 from launch (Expert Riding 800 gold, Artisan Riding 5000 gold); no raid boss drops badges yet, no Zul'Aman, no Isle.
steps.detectedBy: The resolved content phase equals 1; the addon resolves the phase from Questie's ContentPhases.activePhases.TBC when Questie 12.2.0 or newer is loaded, otherwise from its own dated table, and takes the higher of the two.

steps.title: Phase 2: Serpentshrine Cavern and Tempest Keep
steps.detail: Anniversary: Overlords of Outland, announced 15 April 2026 (Blizzard post 24272608), live 14 May 2026 15:00 PDT on all realms; Arena Season 1 ended 4 May 2026 22:00 PDT (US) and Season 2 began with the 19 May 2026 US reset (20 May EU). Classic 2021: patch 2.5.2 on 31 August 2021 (guild banks, group browser), Season 2 from 14 September 2021, Phase 2 unlock 15 September 2021 15:00 PDT. Both times the phase opened Serpentshrine Cavern and Tempest Keep (Anniversary in their post-nerf state), the Ogri'la and Sha'tari Skyguard daily hubs, the Druid Swift Flight Form chain and new profession recipes, and both raids required their attunement: SSC via 10901 The Cudgel of Kar'desh, TK via 10888 Trial of the Naaru: Magtheridon which awards The Tempest Key 31704. On Anniversary that requirement lasted the whole phase; on Classic 2021 Kaivax lifted the SSC and TK attunements together with the final nerfs at the 14 December 2021 US weekly reset (15 December EU), mid phase, which is why Questie's rule of 'attunement required while phase is below 3' is exact for Anniversary and roughly six weeks late for 2021. Heroic keys still cost Revered, badges still come only from heroics and the heroic daily, G'eras is still the only badge vendor, and Hyjal and Black Temple are closed. Questie hides the Phase 2 quests (10955 to 11011 flight form, 11004 to 11885 Ogri'la and Skyguard, 10460 to 10475 Hyjal ring quests, 95158 arena reset) until the phase is 2.
steps.detectedBy: The resolved content phase equals 2 (see phase_1_t4 for how the addon resolves the phase).

steps.title: Phase 3: Hyjal and Black Temple
steps.detail: Anniversary: patch 2.5.6, announced 23 July 2026 (Blizzard post 24291476), raids opened 27 August 2026 15:00 PDT; Arena Season 2 ended 17 August 2026 22:00 PDT with unspent points converted to Honour at 1 to 10, Season 3 began 1 September 2026. Classic 2022: patch 2.5.3 on 18 January 2022 with Season 3 that week (Season 2 ended 11 January 2022), raids opened 27 January 2022 15:00 PST. Both times the phase opened the Battle for Mount Hyjal (entry needs 10445 The Vials of Eternity turned in to Soridormi 19935) and the Black Temple (entry needs the Medallion of Karabor 32649 or its Blessed form 32757 from the chain 10946 Ruse of the Ashtongue, 10947 An Artifact From the Past, 10944 The Secret Compromised, 10948 The Hostage Soul, 10949 Entry Into the Black Temple), added the Netherwing daily hub in Shadowmoon Valley with epic drakes at Exalted, epic gems from Hyjal mining, Black Temple drops and heroic bosses, and Indormi's designs. On Anniversary the SSC and TK attunements were removed when the new raids opened and the skips straight to Vashj and Kael'thas were enabled (Warcraft Tavern 24 and 27 August 2026 reporting Kaivax), and Blizzard added extra tier tokens to the new raids; Karazhan still needs the Master's Key. Heroic keys still cost Revered, no raid boss drops badges, G'eras is still the only badge vendor, Zul'Aman and the Isle are closed. Questie's policy rows drop 10901 and 11052 from 10944's prerequisites and 10888 from 11007's at this phase and unhide the Black Temple chain (10948, 10949, 10957, 10958, 10959, 10985), the Netherwing quests (11012 to 11114) and the Darkmoon decks.
steps.detectedBy: The resolved content phase equals 3 (see phase_1_t4 for how the addon resolves the phase).

steps.title: Phase 3.5 in Blizzard's words: Zul'Aman and the catch-up patch
steps.detail: Anniversary: The Gods of Zul'Aman, announced 8 October 2026, live 22 October 2026 15:00 PDT (Blizzard post 24310652 BCCA: The Gods of Zul'Aman Now Live); this is the phase live today, 24 October 2026, and Arena Season 4 did not start with it. Classic 2022: patch 2.5.4 on 22 March 2022 carried the same bundle and Zul'Aman opened 24 March 2022 at 15:00 PDT. Zul'Aman is a ten player raid in the Ghostlands with six bosses, no attunement, a three day lockout and the timed hostage run for the Amani War Bear 33809. The bundle, identical in both eras: the Battle for Mount Hyjal and the Black Temple no longer require attunement; the reputation requirement to buy heroic dungeon keys is reduced to Honored (standingID 6); all heroic dungeons move to their final reduced 2.4.3 difficulty; Badges of Justice now drop from Doomlord Kazzak and Doomwalker, every boss in Karazhan, Gruul's Lair and Magtheridon's Lair, every boss in Serpentshrine Cavern and Tempest Keep, and every boss in Zul'Aman, but not from Hyjal or Black Temple; G'eras sells more powerful wares and the Nether Vortex 30183; Primal Nether 23572 and Nether Vortex are no longer soulbound; Magtheridon's Black Sack of Gems and Brilliant Glass can hold epic gems; world boss loot becomes Bind on Equip; Outland faction vendors sell Greater Drums, Knothide Quiver and Knothide Ammo Pouch recipes. The heroic daily still pays 2 badges and G'eras is still the only badge vendor; the Isle, Magisters' Terrace and Sunwell remain closed. Questie unhides the Zul'Aman quests (9524, 9525, 11130 Oooh, Shinies!, 11132 Promises, Promises..., 11163 to 11166, 11171, 11178, 11195) at this phase; upstream Questie 12.2.0 of 23 October 2026 set TBC to 4 while the installed 12.1.0 still says 3.
steps.detectedBy: The resolved content phase equals 4 (see phase_1_t4); a saved instance named Zul'Aman, a completed 11130 or 11132, or a Badge of Justice looted inside Karazhan, Gruul's Lair, Magtheridon's Lair, SSC or TK are each proof the live phase is at least 4.

steps.title: Phase 4 in Blizzard's words: Fury of the Sunwell
steps.detail: Anniversary: not yet live; Blizzard's 2026 roadmap lists Fury of the Sunwell for autumn or later in 2026 and no date had been announced by 24 October 2026 (BlizzCon on 12 and 13 September 2026 gave none; World of Warcraft: Forever, a separate product, launches 4 November 2026). Classic 2022: patch 2.5.4a, the Isle of Quel'Danas and Arena Season 4 arrived after the 10 May 2022 US maintenance (Season 3 ended 3 May 2022), Sunwell Plateau opened 12 May 2022 15:00 PDT with all six bosses and no attunement, Season 4 ended 29 August 2022 and the Wrath pre-patch followed on 30 August 2022. Expect the same shape on Anniversary: the Isle with the Shattered Sun Offensive and its realm-wide progression (Questie models nine sub-phases in Modules/Quest/IsleOfQuelDanas.lua: Sun's Reach Sanctum, Sunwell Portal, Sun's Reach Armory, Anvil and Forge, Harbor, Alchemy Lab, Monument, Sun's Reach, Phase 5), Magisters' Terrace in normal and heroic, Sunwell Plateau, Arena Season 4, and new badge vendors on the Isle who unlock as the staging area is reinforced: Smith Hauthaa 25046 appears behind the Sun's Reach Armory once it is retaken and sells Black Temple level gear for badges after the Anvil and Forge are rebuilt (dailies 11535 Making Ready, 11538 The Battle for the Sun's Reach Armory, 11539 Taking the Harbor), Kayri for Veteran PvP pieces, Shaani 25950 for uncut epic gems, with Anwehu and Ontuvo mirroring them in Shattrath. The original 2.4.0 added badges to every raid boss that lacked them, so Hyjal and Black Temple badges are expected here but were not confirmed for 2022 or Anniversary. Questie unhides the Isle and Magisters' Terrace quests (11481 Crisis at the Sunwell, 11482 Duty Calls, 11488 Magisters' Terrace, 11496 to 11557, 11875 to 11880) at this phase, removes Lady Liadrin 17076 and M'uru 17544 from Shattrath, adds Lord Solanar Bloodwrath 25223, and swaps Children's Week 11975 for 10960.
steps.detectedBy: The resolved content phase equals 5 (see phase_1_t4); a completed or accepted 11481, 11482 or 11488, or a saved instance named Sunwell Plateau or Magisters' Terrace, is proof the live phase is at least 5.

guides.notes: Phase numbers in this guide and in the rule table are Questie's 1 to 5. The installed Questie (12.1.0, Interface 20506) sets ContentPhases.activePhases.TBC = 3 and is two days stale: Zul'Aman went live 22 October 2026 and Questie 12.2.0 (2026-10-23) sets it to 4. The addon should never trust Questie's number as a ceiling; take the maximum of Questie's value, its own dated table and any in-game proof (saved instances, completed phase-gated quests, badge loot in a raid).

uncertain: Hyjal and Black Temple bosses dropping Badges of Justice: the original patch 2.4.0 added badges to every raid boss that lacked them, but neither the 2022 Phase 5 announcement (Blizzard post 23789253) nor any fetched 2022 source states it for Classic, and the Anniversary 22 October 2026 list explicitly omits Hyjal and Black Temple. Treat hyjalBtBadges = true in phase 5 as assumed.

Whether the 22 October 2026 reduction of heroic key reputation to Honored also applies to the Anniversary Communal pouches (265829, 265842, 265844, 265846, 265848, 265850): their tooltips on the endpoint still read Requires Revered; the endpoint may lag the live client.

Kaivax's exact wording on the Anniversary Phase 3 removal of the SSC and TK attunements: Warcraft Tavern (24 and 27 August 2026), mmos.com and others report it as Blizzard's statement, but the fetched forum thread 2340643 showed only the raid-open time, extra tier tokens and player questions, not the attunement answer. Bolverk Games' claim that Karazhan, Gruul and Magtheridon attunements were also removed is unsupported: Gruul and Magtheridon never had one and every other source still requires the Master's Key for Karazhan.

Whether account-wide raid attunement on Anniversary lets an alt enter Karazhan without owning The Master's Key 24490 itself (Blizzard's PTR notes say the raid unlocks for the account; the gate mechanics were not described).

Anniversary Arena Season 2 start: Blizzard's forum post says the 19 May 2026 US reset (20 May EU); Warcraft Tavern's Phase 2 article says Season 2 starts with Phase 2 on 14 May. The forum date was used.
Classic 2021 Arena Season 1 start date (mid June 2021) was not confirmed by a fetched source; its end, 7 September 2021, is from Kaivax's 2.5.2 timeline.

Patch 2.5.4 date: the wiki and most mirrors say 22 March 2022, one Blizzard EU forum copy is dated 23 March; Zul'Aman opened 24 March 2022 at 15:00 PDT per Warcraft Tavern and realsport101, not confirmed from a Blizzard page.

Communal Time Pouch is dated patch 2.5.6 on 2026-07-07 by the wiki, while Blizzard's PTR development notes (November 2025) already described the Bind to Battle.net keys; whether the pouches existed from the 5 February 2026 launch or arrived with 2.5.6 was not settled.

Daily dungeon quests on Anniversary from launch (heroic daily 2 badges from Wind Trader Zhareem 24369, normal daily an Ethereum Prison Key from Nether-Stalker Mah'duun 24370) rests on March 2026 guides (iggm, Warcraft Tavern badge guide), not a Blizzard post; for 2021 the 7 June 2021 hotfix only confirms Mah'duun's normal daily being added, the heroic daily is assumed present from launch.
Realm names: no fetched page named Dreamscythe or Nightslayer; the wiki says every normal 20th Anniversary realm moved into Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary on 13 January 2026.

Faction IDs quoted in the notes (Honor Hold 946, Thrallmar 947, Cenarion Expedition 942, Lower City 1011, The Sha'tar 935, Keepers of Time 989, Shattered Sun Offensive 1077, The Violet Eye 967, Ashtongue Deathsworn 1012, Scale of the Sands 990, Netherwing 1015, Ogri'la 1038, Sha'tari Skyguard 1031) are from memory; the tooltip endpoint has no faction route and AtlasLoot's data file keys factions by name, so they were not confirmed here.
Hand of A'dal title for players attuned before the removal: documented for 2022 (Warcraft Tavern Phase 4 page), not mentioned in the Anniversary 22 October 2026 post.
Anniversary phase 5 (Fury of the Sunwell) date: none announced as of 24 October 2026; roadmap wording is autumn or later in 2026. The notes carry nil for its start timestamp.
Quest 10708 and 11052 both resolve to the name Akama's Promise on the endpoint (two versions of the same step); Questie uses 11052 in the pre-phase-3 group and 10708 plus 11052 afterwards.

## 2. Which phase is live today (2026-10-24) and what is next

- **Live: Questie phase 4** (Blizzard "Phase 3.5 – The Gods of Zul'Aman"), since **22 October 2026 15:00 PDT / 22:00 UTC**. Source: Blizzard post 24310652 "BCCA: The Gods of Zul'Aman Now Live", Warcraft Tavern 8 Oct and 22 Oct 2026, Blizzard Watch 9 Oct 2026.
- **Installed Questie 12.1.0 says `TBC = 3`** (stale). **Upstream Questie 12.2.0, released 2026-10-23T22:41Z, sets `TBC = 4`** ("Enable Zul'Aman phase for TBC", commit a1a237a0). Questie bundles typically reach CurseForge within a day, so the addon must not treat Questie's value as a ceiling.
- **Next: Questie phase 5** ("Phase 4 – Fury of the Sunwell"): on Blizzard's 2026 roadmap as autumn / later in 2026, **no date announced** as of today (BlizzCon 12-13 Sept 2026 announced World of Warcraft: Forever, launching 4 Nov 2026, a separate product; Questie has an `IsForever` flag for it). Third-party estimates (late Nov to Dec 2026) are guesses.

## 5. How Questie gates TBC content by phase (so our numbers match)

- `Questie/Database/Corrections/ContentPhases/ContentPhases.lua`: `ContentPhases.activePhases = { ..., TBC = 3 }` (installed 12.1.0; upstream 12.2.0 = 4).
- `ContentPhases/BurningCrusade.lua`: `questsToBlacklistByPhase[1..5]`; `BlacklistTbcQuestsByPhase(list, phase)` blacklists every quest in tables `phase+1 .. 5`. [2] = 10445, 10944, 10946, 10984, 11007, Swift Flight Form 10955-11011, Ogri'la/Skyguard 11004-11885, Hyjal ring 10460-10475 + 10947 + 11103-11106, arena reset 95158/95251/95252. [3] = DMF decks 10938-10941, BT chain 10948/10949/10957/10958/10959/10985, Netherwing 11012-11114. [4] = ZA 9524, 9525, 11130, 11132, 11163-11166, 11171, 11178, 11195. [5] = Isle/MgT 9681, 9684, 9721-9736, 11481-11557, 11875, 11877, 11880.
- Called from `QuestieQuestBlacklist.lua:7052` when `Expansions.Current == Expansions.Tbc`.
- `QuestiePolicy/tbcPolicyCorrections.lua:112-123` (`LoadContentPhaseFixes`): 10944 The Secret Compromised has `preQuestGroup {10901, 11052}` while `TBC < 3`, else `preQuestSingle {10708, 11052}`; 11007 Kael'thas and the Verdant Sphere has `preQuestSingle {10888}` while `< 3`. Comment: "SSC + TK attunements removed in P3".
- `QuestieNPCBlacklist.lua:24-29`: Lady Liadrin 17076 and M'uru 17544 hidden at `>= 5`; Lord Solanar Bloodwrath 25223 hidden at `< 5`; object 178420 Magister Astalor Bloodsworn hidden at `>= 5`.
- `QuestieQuestBlacklist.lua:1353-1366`: 8367/8371/8385/8388 enabled at `>= 2`; 63866/64319 only at `== 5`.
- `Holidays/quests/ChildrensWeek.lua`: 10960 at `>= 5`, 11975 at `< 5`.
- `Modules/QuestieInit.lua:342`: at `== 5` prints the Isle sub-phase reminder; `Modules/Quest/IsleOfQuelDanas.lua`: `Questie.db.global.isleOfQuelDanasPhase` 1..9 (Sun's Reach Sanctum, Sunwell Portal, 2.1 Armory, 3 Anvil and Forge, 3.1 Harbor, 4 Alchemy Lab, 4.1 Monument, 4.2 Sun's Reach, 5), auto-advanced when a quest from a later sub-phase is accepted.
- `QuestieDB/src/corrections/enum/phases.lua` is **not** content phases: it is Blizzard Phase.dbc spawn-visibility IDs plus Questie fake IDs (Cataclysm zones). Ignore it for this feature.
- Reading it at runtime: `local CP = QuestieLoader and QuestieLoader:ImportModule("ContentPhases"); local p = CP and CP.activePhases and CP.activePhases.TBC`.

## 9. Account-wide attunements on Anniversary (Blizzard PTR dev notes, Nov 2025)

Raids: the first character completes the attunement, then the raid unlocks for every character on the Battle.net account. Heroics: the first character reaches Revered ("fully attuned"), buys a Communal pouch, mails the Bind-to-Battle.net key to alts who need only Friendly. Since 22 Oct 2026 the normal keys cost Honored. Karazhan's Master's Key is still required at the door; SSC/TK need nothing since 27 Aug 2026; Hyjal/BT need nothing since 22 Oct 2026.
